title: fncre Symbol Record
description: JSON shape of one fncre.symbols.models.Symbol, as emitted by `fncre symbols ... --json` and `fncre map index --json`.

raw_name.description: Symbol name exactly as it appeared in the MAP, whitespace-trimmed only.

name.description: Normalized name used for lookups (internal whitespace runs collapsed).

demangled_name.description: The MAP's own human-readable form, if raw_name already looked undecorated. Null when raw_name is MSVC-mangled and no demangler has been applied (see docs/provenance.md).

is_mangled.description: True if raw_name starts with '?' (MSVC decoration marker).

address.description: Absolute runtime address (Rva+Base), if the MAP provided one.

section.description: Section name resolved via the segment table (e.g. '.text'), if known.

library.description: Library name from the 'Lib:Object' column, if present.

object_name.description: Object file name from the 'Lib:Object' column.

visibility.description: Which MAP symbol-table section the symbol was listed under.

is_function.description: True/False if the MAP's function flag ('f') made this determinable; null if unknown.

order_index.description: 0-based index in overall parse order (stable across public/static).

source_line.description: 1-based line number in the source MAP file.

namespace_path.description: Everything before the final '::' in name, e.g. 'FightSim'. Null if flat or mangled.

leaf.description: The final '::'-separated component of name, e.g. 'UpdateEnergy'.

address_hex.description: CLI-only convenience field: address formatted as 0xXXXXXXXX. Present only when address is not null.
